author: David Bombal
description:
Cybercriminals are sharing more hacking and fraud tutorials than ever.

Researchers at Radware found more than 3,000 unique hacking and fraud guides on underground forums, with around 110–140 new tutorials appearing every month in 2026.

The focus is changing too. Identity theft and carding tutorials are growing rapidly, while AI is making this type of knowledge easier to create and distribute.

But defenders can also use this intelligence to see what criminals are learning before those techniques become widespread.

Get the full Radware threat advisory report here: https://bit.ly/3VkBLBZ

This video is sponsored by @radware.
